create_ManagedAttribute_with_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor that enforces a specific type when setting values on a class
create_ManagedAttribute_without_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor with no type enforcement for flexible attribute access
review_ManagedAttribute_set_name: review the ManagedAttribute __set_name__ method that maps public attribute names to private backing names
review_ManagedAttribute_get_set: review the ManagedAttribute __get__ and __set__ descriptor methods for type-checked attribute access
refactor_ManagedAttribute_type_check: refactor the ManagedAttribute __set__ method to customize the ValueError message for type mismatches
